title: THE WINDOWS OF HEAVEN

lines.text: The windows of heaven are open,
The blessings are falling to night;
There''s joy, joy, joy in my heart,
I gave Him my old tattered garment,
He gave me a robe of pure white;
I''m feasting on manna from heaven,
And that''s why I''m happy to night.
